weeks.content:
I am special and made with care
My talents list

Marbles for honest acts
Class integrity jar

Respect at home, school, worship
Act each one

Do my best, not the least
Finish strong

Saving and giving basics
Moneywise choices

Choose what builds me
Talk about what we watch

Kindness tree leaves
Fill the tree

Try, try, try again
Story of the persistent child
